queries.name: status_select_model_probe_jobs
queries.statement: 'SELECT body FROM model_probe_jobs WHERE asset_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC'

queries.name: cancel_select_model_probe_jobs
queries.statement: 'SELECT body FROM model_probe_jobs WHERE id=? AND asset_id=?'

queries.name: transfer_select_model_probe_jobs
queries.statement: 'SELECT j.body FROM model_probe_jobs j JOIN model_probe_reservations r ON r.job_id=j.id WHERE j.id=? AND j.device_id=?'

queries.name: effective_profile_select_value
queries.statement: f'SELECT q.manifest_hash,{engine_column} FROM {table} q JOIN {references} r ON r.workspace_id=q.workspace_id AND r.manifest_hash=q.manifest_hash AND r.reference_hash=q.reference_hash' + engine_clause + ' WHERE q.device_id=? AND q.workspace_id=? AND q.profile_hash=?'

queries.name: reference_select_model_engine_references
queries.statement: 'SELECT * FROM model_engine_references WHERE workspace_id=? AND manifest_hash=? AND engine=?'

queries.name: reference_select_model_references
queries.statement: 'SELECT * FROM model_references WHERE workspace_id=? AND manifest_hash=?'

queries.name: accept_select_model_probe_jobs_2
queries.statement: 'SELECT body FROM model_probe_jobs WHERE id=? AND device_id=?'

queries.name: start_select_device_reservations
queries.statement: 'SELECT d.self_test FROM device_reservations r JOIN devices d ON d.id=r.device_id'

queries.name: accept_insert_model_references
queries.statement: 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO model_references VALUES (?,?,?,?)' if not engine_args else 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO model_engine_references VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)'

queries.name: accept_insert_model_qualifications
queries.statement: 'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO model_qualifications VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)' if not engine_args else 'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO model_engine_qualifications VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)'
